Good to know

Questions, answered.

Does ReelVoice upload my recordings?

Core recording and cleaning is designed around on-device processing. Sharing a file is always your choice.

Can I clean video too?

Yes. Video Clean is a separate flow for keeping your video while making its voice easier to hear.

What happens when I use my free minutes?

Free audio and video usage resets by calendar month. The app shows your current allowance.

Where do I manage Pro?

Subscriptions are purchased and managed through Google Play or the App Store.
